description: Tech tree, propulsion and avionics (concept §6.4). Levels 1 and 2 are linear; level 3 is one exclusive choice per branch, once per campaign. The forks are not better and worse — each moves risk somewhere else, and where it lands is the decision. Costs are in research data (§6.3).

levels.title: Turbopump revision B
levels.summary: Fewer moving parts on the feed side.

options.title: Cryogenic upper stage
options.summary: More performance, and a stage that has to stay cold.
options.risk: Propulsion misbehaves more often; the orbit is easier to reach.

options.title: Hypergolic upper stage
options.summary: Storable, ignites on contact, and never quite efficient.
options.risk: Propulsion is quiet; the Δv margin is thin.

levels.title: Redundant sensor bus
levels.summary: The bus stops being a single wire.

options.title: Onboard flight computer
options.risk: Avionics carry the mission; a link outage costs nothing.

options.title: Ground guidance
options.summary: The hard thinking happens where you can fix it.
options.risk: Cheap and light on board; the mission now rides on the downlink.
